description: Editable profiles. Broken means unavailable in the current archive, not necessarily an engine bug. See docs/gameplay-review.md.

review.notes: Cursor attracts meteors. Pointer-only instructions; menu/tutorial opened in Ruffle.
Hold left mouse to control wind. Menu, instructions and level opened in Ruffle.
Remains at checking your login. Intended arrows/Space controls; requires online services.
HTML5 port embedded from https://pr2hub.com/client/. Touch mode selected by the author in anticipation of upcoming touch controls; keyboard input is still needed for now.
Instructions: arrows/WASD move, up jumps, down charges, Space uses item. Online availability pending. Local menu works, but attempting to connect reports Could not connect to the server.
Online racing; controller assignment provisional until server availability is checked. Local menu works, but attempting to connect reports Could not connect to the server.
Blank white player during local review. Embedded Z/X controls; song list is an external PHP endpoint.
Instructions: arrows move, Space shoots; Pause button labelled P. Reaches click-to-play loader.
User-confirmed. Instructions: mouse moves the core; arrows/WASD spin.
User-selected four discrete arrow keys. Choose Arrows in the game menu.
Pointer-only intended controls, but Connect reports Could not connect to the server in the local archive.
Menu offers mouse or arrow play. Touch assumes mouse mode; P is optional pause. Mouse-mode first level starts.
User-confirmed working. Four discrete arrow buttons for movement.
Move pointer to strike; hold left mouse to keep cue steady. Joystick avoids touch-drag acting as a brake.
User-confirmed. Click mines and powerups. P is optional pause.

Arrows/A/D move; mouse aims hand; hold click to grab, release to throw. Direct screen aiming remains available. Animated Play menu opens in Ruffle. Twin sticks: left moves, right aims and holds left mouse while deflected; releasing throws/stops firing. A also clicks at the retained cursor. User confirms P does not pause.
User-confirmed broken. Instructions: left/right paddles, P to resume.
User-confirmed joystick arrows, A P, B disabled.

Live instructions confirm WASD movement, E health potion and Q magic potion. Mouse aims/attacks; potions and attack selection have clickable UI. Hybrid touch ergonomics need review. Twin sticks: left moves, right aims and holds left mouse while deflected; releasing throws/stops firing. A also clicks at the retained cursor.

Live instructions confirm arrows or ASDW movement and clickable weapon selection (also 1–4). First level starts. Mouse attack confirmed by user and repeated A presses verified locally. Twin sticks: left moves, right aims and holds left mouse while deflected; releasing throws/stops firing. A also clicks at the retained cursor. User confirms click attacks.
WASD moves, Space fires, Shift interacts, X/Z zoom. Zoom keys omitted from two-button pad. Menu opens in Ruffle.

Arrow movement, mouse aim, left-click attack. Direct touch aiming plus joystick suggested on mobile. Title screen opens in Ruffle. Twin sticks: left moves, right aims and holds left mouse while deflected; releasing throws/stops firing. A also clicks at the retained cursor.
Black screen with sound icon persists. Embedded text describes typing commands and mentions a click mode.
HTML5 iframe hosted on bubbleracing.com. Native touch/mouse input; no controller.
